thread:
sara: Heads-up — we just got an escalation from a paying customer (saw higher priority flag). They claim the chat responses started inserting unrelated URLs and repeating the same paragraph after yesterday's model sweep rollout (redwood-rlhf-v2). Posting the snippet they pasted: 

Customer snippet: 
```
User: summarize my README
Model: Sure — see full docs at http://example.com/docs.\n\nSummary: This is a readme. This is a readme. This is a readme.
```

They say this is new behavior (never saw the extra link or the repetition). Customer is blocked on a demo tomorrow. Escalation ticket: #INC-4237. Can eng triage? @devon @jamie

devon: On it. Which rollout pool did this go to? Any config changes besides model binary? We also need the API request (headers, model param, max_tokens, temperature).

sara: They provided the request body and headers (redacted API key): 
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model":"redwood-rlhf-v2",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize my README"}],
  "max_tokens":150,
  "temperature":0.2
}
Headers: org-id: org-789
```
They also said latency spiked for that request from 120ms to ~600ms around the rollout time.

jamie: I just checked the rollout logs — v2 was released to prod-canary at 2026-03-12T03:12Z and promoted to prod-all at 2026-03-12T03:42Z. There was a quantization pass change (int8 packing) and a small tokenizer update (emoji normalization). My initial hypothesis: tokenizer change + quantization edge-case caused output truncation/duplication for some prompt shapes.

mike: OK. Customer impact seems real and demo is urgent. We should do a quick rollback to redwood-rlhf-v1 for prod-all and enable model fallback routing for org-789 until we have a fix. Devon, can runtime execute rollback? Jamie, can you prepare a patch re: tokenizer revert?

devon: I can run rollback. Calling the runbook: "Model Rollback — emergency". Steps: 1) pin traffic to previous model on routing plane 2) deploy routing config 3) validate canaries 4) remove v2 from pool. I'll start now.

mike: Deploy-bot, please run: 
```
redwoodctl rollout set --model redwood-rlhf-v1 --scope prod --force --reason "hotfix rollback for INC-4237"
```

deploy-bot: Received command. Starting rollout: pinning traffic to redwood-rlhf-v1 across prod. Will update once canaries pass. :gear:

jamie: Parallel: I'm opening PR to revert the tokenizer normalization (PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5421). If quantization artifacts remain after revert we may need to reload the int8 packing path or fallback to an unquantized variant.

sara: Customer asked for ETA. Can we get them a temporary workaround if rollback takes >15m? They can be routed to a dedicated node we control?

devon: We can enable org-level model override immediately: adding route for org-789 to force v1. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routes add --org org-789 --model redwood-rlhf-v1 --priority 100 --ttl 3600
```
I'll apply that now and post confirmation.

ops-bot: Route applied: org-789 -> redwood-rlhf-v1 (ttl 3600).

devon: Rollback canary looks good — 3/3 canaries passed in ~2 minutes, no errors. Rolling out to remainder of prod. Current traffic re-pointing in progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: redwood-rlhf-v1 is now the default in prod. Old variant redwood-rlhf-v2 removed from routing plane.

mike: Nice. Sara, tell the customer we rolled back and to confirm their demo flow. Also offer a brief call. We should avoid promising root-cause yet.

sara: Noted, I messaged them: "We rolled back to the previous model version (redwood-rlhf-v1) and added a temporary org route. Please retry the demo and ping me if still seeing issues. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." They replied :thumbsup: and said they're testing now.

jamie: For tracking: I've started a debug run reproducer using the exact tokenizer + quantization setup and the customer's prompt. If I can reproduce locally, I'll capture model logits and tokenization diffs. Opening an issue: ML-987 — "v2 tokenizer/quantization regression".

devon: Postmortem/next steps: 1) gather request logs for org-789 around 03:10-03:50Z (sara, can you attach INC-4237 logs?) 2) jamie to attach reproducer + PR 3) infra to add a canary check for tokenization diffs on small prompts 4) product to notify affected customers. I'll create incident runbook entry and schedule 1-hr blameless postmortem.

mike: Assign owners: logs -> sara (support), reproducer -> jamie, routing/infrastructure -> devon, communication -> michelle (product). Ping me when postmortem is scheduled.

sara: Adding incident ticket updates now and emailing customer contact about rollback + call. I'll attach the API request/response pair and latency traces.

mike: Thanks team. If anything else pops up I want immediate updates in this thread. :eyes:
